# Know Your Meme

> > A comprehensive encyclopedia documenting viral internet memes, TikTok trends, catchphrases, and online culture phenomena.

Know Your Meme serves as the definitive database for understanding internet culture, tracking viral content across platforms like TikTok, Twitter/X, Reddit, and YouTube. The site provides both reference documentation for individual memes and editorial guides explaining trending phenomena.

## Key Topics

- TikTok trends and viral videos
- Catchphrases and internet slang
- Exploitable memes and image macros
- Viral meme explanations
- Dance memes and challenges
- Pop culture references
- Social media platforms (Twitter/X, Reddit, Facebook)
- Nostalgia and relatable content
- Hood culture and 90s references
- Looksmaxxing culture
- Mental health memes
- Conspiracy theories
- Breaking Bad references
- WWII poster memes
- Millennial culture

## TikTok Trends & Catchphrases

- [I'm Talking About Innit | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/im-talking-about-innit): TikTok dance trend from BunnaB & YKNiece's 'Innit' with swimming gesture
- [We Still Talk About You | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/we-still-talk-about-you): Exploitable meme featuring art of girl lying over cat, viral on TikTok
- [Millennial Burger Place | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/millennial-burger-place): TikTok trend mocking cliche millennial-style burger restaurant aesthetics
- [How About A Nice Big Cup of Shut the Fuck Up | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/how-about-a-nice-big-cup-of-shut-the-fuck-up): WWII poster-based catchphrase meme trending on TikTok with lip-dubs
